title: Claim
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/pools/claim, application/json, with which the adapter that serves a node pool claims a run waiting for it. Without pool_id the claim covers any node pool the adapter serves; with it, only that pool. A pool the adapter does not serve is refused, 403 forbidden, the same as an unknown one. The control plane holds the request up to wait_seconds while no run waits, and answers a signed 200 with claim-answer.schema.json when one does, or a signed 204 with no body when none came. A run waiting for a pool whose choice resolves to no gateway is refused, 409 no_gateway. It is signed with the adapter's access key as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

pool_id.description: The node pool to claim from. Absent, any node pool the adapter serves.

wait_seconds.description: How long the control plane may hold the request while no run waits, in seconds, from 0 to 25: 0 answers at once.
